js: window.__pick = async (panel, text, filter) => { const sec=[...document.querySelectorAll('section.panel')].find(s=>s.querySelector('header')?.textContent.toUpperCase().includes(panel)); sec.querySelector('.el-select__wrapper').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const inp=sec.querySelector('input'); inp.value=filter; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const opt=[...document.querySelectorAll('.el-select-dropdown__item')].find(o=>o.textContent.includes(text)); if(!opt) return 'Option fehlt: '+text; opt.click(); return 'gewählt: '+opt.textContent.trim(); }; return 'Hilfe da'
return await window.__pick('GESCHOSS', '30 Cal. 150 gr BTSP', '150 gr BTSP')

const set=(label,val)=>{const item=[...document.querySelectorAll('.el-dialog .el-form-item')].find(i=>i.querySelector('label')?.textContent.trim()===label); const inp=item?.querySelector('input'); if(!inp) return label+' fehlt'; inp.value=val; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return label}; return [set('Hersteller','Prüfmodus'),set('Bezeichnung','Testgeschoss 999'),set('Geschoss-Ø','7.82'),set('Geschossmasse','150'),set('Geschosslänge','29.5'),set('Spitzenlänge (bis voller Ø)','14.2')]

const l=await window.api.libraryList('projectile'); const e=l.find(x=>x.label.includes('Testgeschoss 999')); if(!e) return 'nicht in der Bibliothek'; const r=await window.api.libraryRecord(e.id); await window.api.libraryDelete(e.id); const still=(await window.api.libraryList('projectile')).some(x=>x.id===e.id); return {gespeichert: e.label, gtip: r.gtip, glen: r.glen, wiederGeloescht: !still}
